picks.title: Suno brings its gen AI music to iMessage
picks.excerpt: Suno added an iMessage keyboard extension that lets iPhone users generate a ~30-second AI song from a text or voice prompt without leaving Messages, alongside a new Mashup feature that fuses any two tracks. It pushes prompt-to-song generation into an everyday, conversational surface.
picks.rationale: Fresh Suno release that pushes prompt-to-song generation into an everyday messaging surface — a concrete new distribution channel creators can try immediately.

picks.title: AI's new USB port: what the MCP standard means for the music industry
picks.excerpt: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is emerging as the connective 'USB port' that lets music-industry platforms wire their catalogues and data directly into ChatGPT, Claude and other AI assistants, so creators and teams can query many tools at once. It signals how AI music workflows will plug together rather than live in silos.
picks.rationale: Explains the MCP standard now wiring music platforms into AI assistants — a workflow shift that changes how creators and teams query their tools going forward.

picks.title: AI-generated tracks now account for more than 50% of Deezer's uploads
picks.excerpt: Deezer says fully AI-generated music now makes up more than half of daily uploads, averaging around 90,000 tracks a day in June — a milestone showing generative-AI tools now out-produce human uploads on a major platform. Deezer is purging AI tracks tied to stream fraud or left unplayed for six months.
picks.rationale: Landmark data point — AI now out-produces humans on a major platform — that reframes the distribution landscape every releasing artist has to compete in.
